readme: Fixtures are real vault notes, pinned by sha256 and materialized into the
gitignored .frozen/ by `run.py freeze`. Only the pointer lives in git: this
repository is public and the notes are not.
A drifted hash is not an error, it is a signal - the note changed and the
numbers stop being comparable until it is re-pinned deliberately.
`excerpt` is applied at freeze time so the sha of what the model saw is the
sha on disk. `head` keeps the frontmatter, which several cases score against.

meeting-kickoff.note: Internal project kickoff. Real first names and affiliations as speaker labels, so its answer key lives in the gitignored expectations/.private/. Included because a webinar panel has opinions where a kickoff has owners and deadlines, and owners and deadlines are what the case measures. Excerpted from the call to order: the first eight minutes are pre-meeting small talk carrying third-party medical detail — a colonoscopy, a medication reaction, childbirth — about named people who are not the vault owner. None of that is meeting content, and a benchmark corpus is not the place for it.
